name: cloudflare-openai-agents-api-basic
description: Basic Cloudflare Worker for webhook-managed OpenAI Agents API sessions.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI application key used by the TypeScript SDK to create sessions, submit input, and retrieve results.

OPENAI_AGENT_ID.description: OpenAI agent ID configured in the executor Worker.

EXECUTOR_URL.description: Deployed OpenAI Agents API executor Worker URL without the /webhook path.

EXECUTOR_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Bearer token configured on the executor Worker for manual Container cleanup.

TASK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.description: Maximum duration of one agent task in seconds (default: 600).
